missing_aspects: Rule determining which reporter receives the reward when multiple people report the same cash receipt refusal violation
coverage_assessments.rationale: No supplied provision contains the rule determining which of multiple reporters receives the reward for the same cash receipt refusal violation. C001/C002 and C003/C004 relate to the Direct Selling Act, not the cash receipt system. C011 is under the Agricultural Land Act. C012, C013, C016, C017, C018, C019, C020 are either generic delegation clauses or concern different statutes. C025 provides the reward amount and annual cap for cash receipt refusal but does not specify the priority rule for multiple reporters of the same violation. Therefore, the completion criteria for E1 remain unsatisfied.

C025 (국세기본법 시행령 65조 4 포상금의 지급 19항) explicitly states the annual reward cap for reporting cash receipt refusal: '동일인에게 지급할 수 있는 포상금은 연간 100만원을 한도로 한다.' This directly satisfies the completion criteria for E2, which requires confirmation of the annual reward cap amount for reporting cash receipt refusal.
